interview.name: Quinn
interview.answer: Quinn hasn’t confirmed the time or location yet; they’re still gathering the final date and address.

reflections: Quinn is actively coordinating community support for the repair drive and acting as a central point of contact.
Tess is supportive and responsive, offering to track needs and provide updates without taking over the coordination role.
Cleo is willing to contribute supplies, and Quinn reinforces participation by publicly acknowledging help and extending the invite list.
Quinn is the main organizer and information hub for the repair drive, keeping people updated and spreading the word.
Cleo is an active, dependable helper who offers supplies and follows through by showing up for updates.
Nell wants clearer timing details to help relay information accurately, showing the group is coordinating through informal channels.
Quinn is a central coordinator who keeps neighbors informed, manages invites, and tracks updates for the repair drive.
The group is cooperative and reciprocal: people offer supplies, ask for details, and thank Quinn for keeping them in the loop.
There is shared concern around practical needs for the repair drive, especially tools, donations, and logistics like address and time.
Quinn is the central coordinator, repeatedly collecting and forwarding event details to keep others informed.
Hana, Noah, and Nell are all dependent on Quinn for logistics and show a shared willingness to help spread the word once details are confirmed.
The group’s main friction is missing final event specifics like date, address, and time, so communication is organized around staying on the invite list and awaiting updates.
Quinn is coordinating a repair drive and is the main source of confirmed details, so others are waiting on Quinn for timing and logistics.
Noah and Nell both rely on follow-up updates and want clearer timing, with Nell acting as a relay to spread the word.
Oren is moving from interest to contribution by bringing tools and supplies, showing the repair drive is drawing concrete participation.

events.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a good turnout already—folks are really showing up with tools and supplies. If you want, I can keep an ear out for what they still need.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Quinn: That’d be great, Tess—thank you! I’m already telling a few neighbors to swing by, and I’ll keep passing along the word.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Tess: You bet—I’ll let you know if I hear they need anything specific. It’s nice to see everyone pitching in.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Quinn: Oh, the repair drive? I’m telling folks about it today—come by if you can, and I’ll make sure you’re on the invite list.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Cleo: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll stop by and make sure I’m on the invite list. If you need anything for the repair drive, I’ve got some supplies on hand.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Quinn: That’d be great, Cleo—bring whatever you can spare, and I’ll let everyone know you’re helping out.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn — I’m still hearing things second-hand, so a clear time would help me spread the word. If you hear anything, please let me know.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’m checking the time now and I’ll let you know as soon as I’ve got it. I’ll keep spreading the word either way.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn — I appreciate it. I’ll keep an ear out and pass the time along once you know it.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Quinn: That’s wonderful, Cleo—thank you! Bring whatever you can spare, and I’ll keep spreading the word so everyone knows you’re pitching in.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Cleo: Happy to help — I’ll bring what I can spare and stop by for the update.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Quinn: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll make sure you get the latest update, and I’ll keep letting neighbors know to come by for the repair drive.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Leo — I’m spreading the word about the repair drive today, and I’ll make sure you’re on the invite list too.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Leo: Thanks, Quinn — much appreciated. If you hear of any donations, send them my way, and I’ll keep an eye out for the screwdriver set and work gloves.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Quinn: You got it, Leo — I’ll pass along any donations I hear about and keep an eye out for that screwdriver set and those work gloves too.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Hana: Thanks, Quinn — what details do we have so far on the repair drive?
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Quinn: We’ve got a solid turnout and folks are bringing tools and supplies; I’m still gathering the latest details today. If you want, I’ll keep you on the invite list and pass along any updates as I hear them.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Hana: Thanks, Quinn — please keep me on the invite list, and send me the address and time once you have them.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Noah: I’m still a little behind, but thanks for catching me up. If you have the date and address, I can help keep an eye out for the details.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’m still collecting the final date and address, and I’ll pass them along as soon as I have them. I’ll keep you on the invite list too.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Noah: Thanks, Quinn — I appreciate it. I’ll watch for your message and try not to miss it this time.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn — I’m still hearing things second-hand, so a clear time would help me spread the word. If you hear anything, please let me know.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’m still confirming the time, and I’ll let you know as soon as it’s set so you can pass it along.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn — I appreciate it. I’ll keep an ear out and pass the time along once you know it.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’m still gathering the final date and address, and I’ll send them over as soon as I have them. Thanks for keeping an eye out for the repair drive!
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Noah: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll keep an eye out and try not to miss the update again.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Quinn: Of course — I’ll send the repair drive details as soon as they’re confirmed, and I’m still spreading the word to neighbors in the meantime.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’ve got the screws and duct tape, and I’m still trying to find a decent wrench too.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Quinn: That’s great, Oren — bring what you’ve got, and I’ll keep spreading the word so neighbors know to stop by with any tools or supplies.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Oren: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll keep hunting for that wrench and bring the screws and duct tape.
events.speaker: Oren
